words.meaning: The treatment and interplay of light and shade in drawing, painting, or dramatic artistic composition.
words.sentence1: The painter perfected the use of chiaroscuro to give dramatic depth to the portrait. (The painter perfected the use of chiaroscuro to give dramatic depth to the portrait.)
words.sentence2: In classical cinema, intense chiaroscuro evokes mystery and psychological tension. (In classical cinema, intense chiaroscuro evokes mystery and psychological tension.)

words.meaning: Exquisite skill, delicate beauty, or refined craftsmanship in an artistic work.
words.sentence1: El artesano esculpio la figura de madera con absoluto primor. (The artisan carved the wooden figure with absolute delicate craftsmanship.)
words.sentence2: Cada detalle del bordado refleja el primor del diseno tradicional. (Every detail of the embroidery reflects the exquisite beauty of traditional design.)

words.meaning: A masterpiece; a work of outstanding artistry, technique, and beauty.
words.sentence1: Cette sculpture en marbre est consideree comme un veritables chef-d'oeuvre de la Renaissance. (This marble sculpture is considered a true Renaissance masterpiece.)
words.sentence2: Le musee presente le chef-d'oeuvre le plus celebre du peintre impressionniste. (The museum presents the impressionist painter's most celebrated masterpiece.)

words.meaning: Perfection of form; consummate aesthetic balance and stylistic mastery.
words.sentence1: Die Symphonie besticht durch ihre auBergewohnliche Formvollendung. (The symphony captivates with its extraordinary perfection of form.)
words.sentence2: In dieser Skulptur verbindet sich reine Harmonie mit vollendeter Formvollendung. (In this sculpture, pure harmony unites with consummate perfection of form.)

words.meaning: Courtly elegance, refined aesthetic beauty, and graceful artistic charm.
words.sentence1: Koten bungaku no sekai ni wa miyabi ga irozuku. (In the world of classical literature, courtly elegance flourishes.)
words.sentence2: Sono teien wa kodai no miyabi o ima ni tsutaete iru. (That garden conveys the refined elegance of ancient times to the present day.)

words.meaning: Graceful elegance, light and charming physical or artistic beauty.
words.sentence1: I movimenti della ballerina erano colmi di naturale leggiadria. (The dancer's movements were filled with natural graceful elegance.)
words.sentence2: L'affresco ritrae una figura angelica di rara leggiadria. (The fresco depicts an angelic figure of rare, charming beauty.)

words.meaning: Artistic conception; the poetic atmosphere and profound evocative mood of an artwork.
words.sentence1: Zhe fu shanshui hua de yijing feichang shenyuan. (The artistic atmosphere of this landscape painting is profoundly deep.)
words.sentence2: Gudian shici zong shi zhuiqiu du te de yijing. (Classical poetry always pursues a unique artistic conception.)

words.meaning: Artistic flair, natural charm, tastefulness, and stylish aesthetic grace.
words.sentence1: Hanbok eun teukyu ui gokseon meot eul gajigo itda. (The hanbok possesses the unique aesthetic flair of curved lines.)
words.sentence2: Geu hwarang eun gojeon gwa hyeondae ui meot eul joghwa ropge damatda. (That gallery harmoniously captures both classical and modern artistic charm.)

words.meaning: Aesthetic beauty, elegance, splendor, and graceful physical or visual charm.
words.sentence1: Prasat Angkor Wat ban bandoch sophonpheap khoh bi kee. (Angkor Wat temple radiates unmatched aesthetic splendor.)
words.sentence2: Komrou neak robam ban banghan sophonpheap nay silapakhar boran. (The dancer's postures displayed the beauty and elegance of traditional art.)

words.meaning: Beauty; aesthetic excellence that pleases the senses and elevates the spirit.
words.sentence1: Die kunstenaar vang die tydlose skoonheid van die landskap vas. (The artist captures the timeless beauty of the landscape.)
words.sentence2: Daar is 'n diep skoonheid in die eenvoud van hierdie skildery. (There is a deep beauty in the simplicity of this painting.)
